pages.title: Decoctions
pages.text: The decoctions are special, very strong potions made with $(l:tcots_witcher:alchemy_basics/basic_ingredients)monsters mutagens.

Similar to potions, they need to be drunk and they can be $(l:tcots_witcher:alchemy_basics/refilling)refilled$(/l), however you only can carry one in one space and they can't be upgraded.$(br2)The $(l:tcots_witcher:alchemy_basics/toxicity)toxicity levels$(/l) of decoctions are so high that usually you can only drink one at the time, but the effects are so strong that you usually don't need more than that.$(br)$(li)$(n)Note: The monster mutagens can be only acquired using looting
